Import packages
```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(Lab4PKG)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(tidyr)
library(caret)
```

Data information
```{r}
cat("Flights dim:", nrow(nycflights13::flights),"rows and", ncol(nycflights13::flights),"columns.\n")
cat("Weather dim:", nrow(nycflights13::weather),"rows and", ncol(nycflights13::weather),"columns.\n")
```


```{r}
cat("Flights data: ",colnames(nycflights13::flights),"\n")
cat("Weather data: ",colnames(nycflights13::weather),"\n")
```

Plan : Take time_hour,wind_speed, wind_dir and wind_gust, visib from weather data.
  Take time_hour, arr_delay and match with origin and time


Filter Weather data
```{r}
weather_filterd <- nycflights13::weather |> 
  select("time_hour", "wind_speed", "wind_dir", "wind_gust", "visib", "origin") 
weather_filterd
  
```

Filter Flights data
```{r}
flights_filtered <- nycflights13::flights |> 
  select("time_hour", "arr_delay", "origin") 
flights_filtered

```


Join both data sets with the useful parts      
```{r}
flights_weather <- left_join(flights_filtered, weather_filterd, suffix = c("time_hour","origin")) |> 
  relocate(origin, .before = time_hour)
flights_weather
```


A problem in the data is the wind_dir column which specifies wind direction in degrees.
But if we think about it, wind_dir 10 and wind_dir 350 are prettey close to each other,
but mathematically they are far away and the model would not see them as similar.

To solve that issue the unit circle rules are used and split the wind_dir column into
x and y variables in a coordinate system.

And also totaly filter data so its ready for the model.

```{r}
delay_dataset <- flights_weather |> 
  mutate(wind_x = cos(wind_dir * pi/180), wind_y = sin(wind_dir * pi/180), wind_dir = NULL) |> 
  select(!c("origin", "time_hour","wind_gust")) |> #remove wind_gust from data because it has many NA 3/4 of data
  drop_na()
    
delay_dataset
```
```{r}
#Split data into 5% test, 15% validation and 80% training data
train_idx <- createDataPartition(delay_dataset$arr_delay, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- delay_dataset[train_idx, ]
rest_data <- delay_dataset[-train_idx, ]

validation_idx <- createDataPartition(rest_data$arr_delay, p = 0.75, list = FALSE)
validation_data <- rest_data[validation_idx, ]
test_data <- rest_data[-validation_idx, ]
```

```{r}
#validate dthe split
nrow(train_data) / nrow(delay_dataset)
nrow(validation_data) / nrow(delay_dataset)
nrow(test_data) / nrow(delay_dataset)
```


###Root mean squared error function (RMSE)
```{r}
rmse <- function(error) return(sqrt(mean(error^2)))
```

###Evalute different lambda values
```{r}
lambdas <- 10^seq(-2, 6, by = 1)
total_error <- numeric(length(lambdas))
form <- formula(arr_delay ~ wind_speed +  visib + wind_x + wind_y + wind_speed:wind_x + wind_speed:wind_y)

for(i in seq_along(lambdas)){
  
  mod <- ridgereg$new(formula = form, data = train_data, lambda = lambdas[i])

  pred <- mod$predict(newdata = validation_data)
  error <- validation_data$arr_delay - pred
  
  total_error[i] <- rmse(error)
}
cat("Completed!")
```

###Find best lambda value
```{r}
min_error <- min(total_error)
min_error_idx <- which(total_error==min(total_error))
best_lambda <- lambdas[min_error_idx]
cat("Min RMSE:",min_error,"idx:",min_error_idx,"Lambda:",best_lambda,"\n")

```

###Test the test data with the best lambda value
```{r}
test_mod <- ridgereg$new(formula = form, data = train_data, lambda = best_lambda)
test_pred <- test_mod$predict(test_data)
test_error <- test_data$arr_delay - test_pred
test_rmse <- rmse(test_error)
test_rmse #minutes in error for the test data
```
